name: Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection

scope.definition: All works documented in the 2007 Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection catalogue. 386 works by 108 Latvian artists, as listed on catalogue pages 222–229.
scope.source: Žeivaite, Ilze, et al. Hansabankas mūsdienu mākslas kolekcija / Hansabanka Contemporary Art Collection. Rīga: Hansabanka, 2007. (SRC-HANSABANKA-2007, Wikidata Q139986317)

listing.description: 386 works by 108 Latvian artists collected by Hansabanka between 1998 and 2007, documenting a decade of contemporary Latvian art. Now held by Swedbank Latvia.
